Worst experience, first and last time here.

Review from a real, paid experience.

The management was absolutely terrible. As soon as I arrived, the equipment was broken. I waited a very long time for them to fix it (about an hour), but the equipment was still unusable. They spent a long time searching for replacements, and in the end, everything was broken. During the procedure, the assistant said the equipment might explode – what?! It was terrifying.

In the end, the dentist said they didn't need to charge the patient because it wasted the patient's time and the work wasn't finished.

However, the staff claimed the owner told them to charge the patient, even though the equipment was broken, they hadn't even worked on half of the lower teeth, and the upper teeth hadn't even started. **The owner wasn't even there.**

I am utterly appalled. I've never experienced anything like this before.
Even the dentist knew they shouldn't charge the patient,
but the owner, who wasn't present, shifted the burden onto the customer.

Edit: Photo of the teeth that the clinic confirmed the customer paid for.

(The front desk staff insisted the clinic owner told them to pay. When I asked to speak to the owner, the staff said, "They won't talk to you. That's what they said." I asked if that was normal, and the staff just said, "Yes," and couldn't say much more…)

I recommend that when reading reviews, check carefully if the customer is genuine and how the clinic handles the problem.
